preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 400,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (u, v) must have vertex indices between 1 and n inclusive.
The input must contain exactly n-1 edges, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: No edge connects a vertex to itself.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] in {0, 1} for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each output value must be either 0 or 1.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == 1 if exists_edge_replacement_to_centroid(i, edges, n) else output[i] == 0 for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each vertex i, output 1 if it can be made a centroid by replacing at most one edge, otherwise output 0.
